cues.text: A bright streak of light trails through a starry twilight sky of bruised purple and fiery orange as the colony ship descends.
It falls toward a vast, silent desert of rust-red dust and jagged, wind-swept rocks.
In the foreground, a giant, dark insectoid creature stands atop a rocky outcropping.
In the background, a sprawling city of pale stone rises from the plains.

beats.note: A starry twilight sky of purple and orange over a red desert. A bright streak of light, the colony ship, descends on the right.
The desert landscape features rust-red dust and jagged rocks.
A giant, dark insectoid creature stands on a rocky outcropping in the foreground.
In the background, a sprawling city of pale stone with tall spires rises from the plains.
